free_links.label: Public conference abstract with tables
free_links.evidence: Publisher-indexed abstract and both tables read 2026-09-12; direct retrieval rate-limited; heatmap still pending.

records.relation_note: 826 sarcoma samples overall; Table 1 lists CRIM1 overexpression in an Extraskeletal myxoid sarcoma subgroup. Subgroup size and molecular confirmation are not given. Table 2 does not isolate EMC; its FOLR1 row is endometrial stromal sarcoma. RNA findings are not validated surface-protein or ADC-response evidence.

records.title: A Study of R1507 in Participants With Recurrent or Refractory Sarcoma
records.authors: Hoffmann-La Roche; Sarcoma Alliance for Research through Collaboration

free_links.label: Free posted trial results
free_links.evidence: Primary ClinicalTrials.gov API results retrieved 2026-09-12; explicitly named EMC cohort.

records.relation_note: EMC cohort 7c: 11 participants; no complete/partial responses. Reported PFS figures and population descriptions are internally inconsistent and remain unreconciled. This results posting and the 2014 R1507 paper are related reports of the same trial, not independent studies. No randomized EMC comparator.
